baseline_models.mechanism: Inspection, advance, and hand-attributed action converge: the person encounters as an object of sight or insight what his own agency had already projected ahead.

activation_trace.role: Directing sight or insight toward a thing supplies the inspecting act that makes prior action present evidence.
Advance and precedence supply the forward projection by which deeds are already waiting at the encounter.
Attribution of work or offense to the two hands makes the inspected evidence emphatically the person's own action.

changed_reading.before: On that day a person sees a record of past deeds.
changed_reading.after: The scene is direct self-evidence: the person's own embodied agency has sent forward the very object now placed under inspection.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: عَذَابًا قَرِيبًا يَوْمَ ... مَا قَدَّمَتْ ... يَٰلَيْتَنِى كُنتُ تُرَٰبًا
baseline_models.mechanism: Three temporal vectors collide: the punishment draws near, deeds have gone ahead, and the final speaker reaches backward with a wish to have been earth. The day is where advancing consequence defeats retrospective un-becoming.

activation_trace.role: Temporal nearness and an approaching reckoning supply the incoming vector of the warned event.
A day used for a severe occurring event supplies the point at which the opposed temporal vectors meet.
Going ahead supplies the outbound vector of actions that precede their actor into the day.
Being or occurring in a past time supplies the counterfactual backward reach of 'I had been.'
Literal earth and dust supply the pre-agent material state into which the speaker tries retrospectively to retreat.

changed_reading.before: A near future punishment causes a wish for nonexistence.
changed_reading.after: Nearness is a temporal collision: deeds arrive from the person's own past while the person makes an impossible backward bid to have remained mere earth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah moves from reciprocal questioning about an arriving report, through divergent paths and twice-promised knowing, to one person's inspection. Publicly circulating uncertainty becomes privately inescapable evidence.

activation_trace.role: Reciprocal questioning supplies the opening state of socially distributed uncertainty.
A report that comes and is conveyed supplies the disputed object moving toward its recipients.
Each party taking a path unlike another supplies the divergence that keeps the report contested.
Disclosure of a thing to the knower supplies the promised collapse of uncertainty.
Sight joined with examination realizes the promised knowing as an individual encounter with evidence.

structural_cues: 78:1-3 opens with questioning, a report, and disagreement; 78:40 closes with a singular person's seeing.
The knowing promise is repeated in 78:4-5 before the surah supplies the scene finally seen.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mutual inquiry, an incoming report, divergence, disclosure, and final inspection; I infer an epistemic arc from public dispute to private certainty. A live alternative is that يَنظُرُ remains only visual witnessing, without carrying the opening dispute's resolution.

changed_reading.before: The person merely looks at deeds on judgment day.
changed_reading.after: The look is the terminal answer to the opening controversy: what was discussed at a distance is now resolved as self-involving evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: A made and prepared support system precedes human action: ground is readied, supports are fixed, rest cuts activity, day enables livelihood, and hidden growth is brought out. Against that input-and-output sequence, 'what his hands advanced' reads as the human output produced with supplied capacity and conditions.

activation_trace.role: Making a thing take on a condition supplies the deliberate construction of the action environment.
Preparing and leveling an affair supplies an enabled field rather than an inert backdrop.
Peg-like upright stability supplies fixed support within the prepared field.
Cutting and cessation supply the interrupting phase that makes the rest-work cycle functional.
Livelihood and means of living supply the intended operating field for human activity.
Bringing a thing out of concealment supplies the system's visible output and anticipates disclosed human output.
The hand as capacity supplies the proximate human power operating within the prepared system.
Advancing an output supplies the hand's consequential production that outlasts the moment of action.

structural_cues: 78:6-16 repeatedly attributes making, building, sending down, and bringing out before 78:40 attributes an advance to human hands.
The sequence moves from stable supports and alternating rest-work conditions to water, grain, vegetation, and gardens.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prepared supports, functional cycles, livelihood, visible output, and the focus hand's capacity; I infer that accountable deeds are outputs made possible inside that provisioned system. A live alternative is that the creation list proves power only and does not characterize human responsibility as production within supplied conditions.

changed_reading.before: The hands are simply a bodily idiom for whatever deeds a person committed.
changed_reading.after: The hands mark accountable productive capacity: the person sees what was made from a world and life-system already prepared for use.

context_deltas.mechanism: The day is a fixed separating threshold at which closed sky opens and solid mountains are displaced into mirage. The focus counterfactual then attempts one more state-change, but backward: from accountable person to prior dust.

activation_trace.role: Separating one thing from another until a boundary appears supplies the day's decisive threshold.
A struck appointment supplies exact timing rather than vague proximity.
Opening what was closed supplies the first large-scale category change at the threshold.
Removal and displacement supply the loss of the mountains' former fixed condition.
A mirage that gleams like water supplies the mountains' replacement appearance without their former substance.
Past being supplies the grammar of the speaker's attempted reverse transformation.
Dust supplies the desired terminal category at the end of the failed reverse movement.

structural_cues: 78:17 names the day as both separation and appointment before 78:19-20 narrates two transformations.
The repeated كان/كانت transformation clauses in 78:17, 78:19, 78:20, and 78:21 precede the focus speaker's كنت.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a separating appointment, opening, displacement, mirage, and repeated being-grammar; I infer that the threshold makes prior categories irreversibly answerable and that the dust-wish asks for reversal. A live alternative is that the cosmic changes and the wish are parallel images with no shared directionality.

changed_reading.before: The punishment is near because it will occur soon, and the speaker wishes to be dust.
changed_reading.after: The nearness is an appointed categorical threshold; after the world changes forward, the speaker's 'I had been dust' is a grammatically matched but unavailable reverse change.

context_deltas.mechanism: Watchfulness, experiential tasting, matching recompense, calculation, exhaustive counting, binding inscription, and increase form an audit-to-experience chain. The deeds seen in the focus are not loose memories; they are closed evidence whose fitted consequence is undergone.

activation_trace.role: Watching and guarding supply the surveillance end of the evidentiary mechanism.
Experiencing and undergoing a thing supply the conversion of judgment from record into felt condition.
Answering an act with its recompense supplies the causal return from deed to consequence.
A measure equal to need or counterpart supplies proportional fit between action and return.
Counting and accounting supply the denied procedure that nevertheless governs the outcome.
Exhaustive enumeration supplies completeness, preventing an action from escaping the account.
An inscription that fixes a ruling or determination supplies the record's binding force.
Increase and growth supply the accumulating continuation of the experienced consequence.
Inspection supplies the person's direct access to the completed evidentiary object.
Hand-attributed action identifies whose conduct populates the completed account.
Painful punishment supplies the embodied output of the audit chain named in the warning.

structural_cues: 78:21-30 runs from an observing station through tasting and fitting recompense to total inscription and increase.
78:27 denies expectation of an account immediately before 78:29 asserts that every thing has been exhaustively counted in writing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies surveillance, experience, recompense, fit, accounting, exhaustive inscription, and increase; I connect them as one pipeline from deed to undergone result. A live alternative is that these are adjacent descriptions of judgment without specifying a single evidentiary process.

changed_reading.before: The person sees deeds and then receives punishment.
changed_reading.after: Seeing exposes a complete audit whose entries, fit, and ownership are converted into the very punishment experienced.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same judgment sequence bifurcates economically: punitive recompense is described through exact fit, while the protected side reaches saving success and receives a giving characterized by sufficiency. The final dust-wish therefore belongs to a differentiated outcome, not to the day as an undivided catastrophe.

activation_trace.role: Recompense answering an act supplies the shared judgment category on the punitive side.
A measure equal to its counterpart makes punitive return specifically fitted rather than indiscriminate.
Placing oneself in protection supplies the contrasting recipient posture.
Attaining good and escape supplies the successful outcome opposite the punitive return.
Handing over and giving supply a grant register on the protected side rather than mere equivalence.
Sufficiency and adequacy supply the possibility that the gift exceeds a narrowly itemized wage.
Covering or denying truth identifies the final wisher as one side of the already divided outcomes.
Punitive pain identifies which branch of the differentiated day the warning foregrounds.

structural_cues: 78:21-30 gives the punitive sequence; 78:31-36 pivots explicitly to the protected and a successful outcome.
جزاء appears on both sides, while وفاق qualifies the first and عطاء qualifies the second.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fitted recompense, protection, saving success, giving, and sufficiency; I infer an asymmetry between exact punitive return and ample gift. A live alternative is that حسابا in 78:36 means strictly measured quantity, making both sides more symmetrical.

changed_reading.before: The near day is a uniform economy in which deeds simply yield punishment.
changed_reading.after: The day discriminates between economies: the coverer's painful return fits what was advanced, while the contrasting side is framed through protection, success, and sufficient gift.

context_deltas.mechanism: Address is not possessed, the assembly is aligned, and intelligible speech passes through permission and rightness. The focus quote consequently sounds less like an available plea or negotiation and more like exposed, non-operative regret.

activation_trace.role: Possession and power of disposal supply the speech capacity explicitly denied to the gathered speakers.
Exchange of address supplies the unavailable dialogic channel, ruling out ordinary negotiation.
Alignment on a level row supplies the formal, regulated setting in which speech is constrained.
Intelligible utterance connecting speakers supplies the speech act placed under restriction.
Permission and authorization supply the gate through which any effective speech must pass.
Rightness settled opposite error supplies the content condition joined to permission.
An utterance brought into speech supplies the coverer's quoted wish inside the restricted speech environment.

structural_cues: 78:37 denies possession of address; 78:38 restricts speaking; 78:40 nevertheless presents one final utterance.
The focus speech has wish grammar rather than request, argument, denial, or defense.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies no ownership of address, regulated alignment, authorized speech, right speech, and the final quote; I infer that the wish has no operative force as a defense. A live alternative is that the quote itself is an authorized utterance, or a report of inner speech rather than an attempted address.

changed_reading.before: The coverer verbally asks or hopes to become dust.
changed_reading.after: After ordinary address and negotiation have closed, the utterance remains only self-exposing regret: grammatically voiced, but unable to alter the account.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah names one return-place for boundary-crossers and offers taking a return toward the Lord before the true day. The focus dust-wish is therefore a third imagined destination that is not a route at all: an attempted retreat from accountable agency after destination has resolved.

activation_trace.role: Crossing the limit in disobedience supplies the trajectory whose return-place is punitive.
Return to a place supplies the first destination, the boundary-crossers' punitive homecoming.
Reality fixed against falsehood supplies the point before which a route can no longer remain merely disputed.
Will directed toward a thing supplies the voluntary orientation of the offered route.
Taking and acquiring supply the enactment that turns orientation into an adopted route.
Lordship, possession, and sovereignty supply the relational endpoint toward which the second return is taken.
Return to a place supplies the second destination, now explicitly oriented toward the Lord.
Counterfactual past being supplies the late attempt to substitute ontology for a taken route.
Dust supplies the imagined non-destination in which accountable personhood would be abandoned.

structural_cues: The same مآبا form marks the punitive return in 78:22 and the return taken toward the Lord in 78:39.
The route invitation in 78:39 immediately precedes the post-inspection wish in 78:40.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two return destinations, will, taking, truth, and the subsequent dust counterfactual; I infer that route-taking precedes final disclosure and that dust cannot function as a late third route. A live alternative is that 78:39 offers orientation without implying a temporal limit on choosing it.

changed_reading.before: The coverer wishes for annihilation to escape punishment.
changed_reading.after: The wish is failed navigation: after refusing the available return toward the Lord and arriving at the boundary-crossers' return, the speaker invents dust as an impossible non-route.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the agricultural covering branch is form-distant from the ordinary denier sense of ٱلْكَافِرُ. It remains valid as a root-level activation because the focus itself joins ك ف ر to literal dust, while earlier covering images make the relation visible. Downstream prose should present it only as a contained lexical reversal, not as a replacement gloss for 'the disbeliever.'

activation_trace.role: Covering by a garment supplies an earlier material instance of concealment in the surah's image field.
Covering and concealment supply a second context image that keeps the cover relation active.
The cultivator who covers seed with soil supplies the odd agent-to-material relation activated by the final noun.
Literal earth and dust supply the covering material the root-distant coverer now wishes to become.

changed_reading.before: The denier wishes to cease as a person and become inert dust.
changed_reading.after: At the level of lexical resonance, the one named by covering wishes to collapse from covering agent into covering matter, an inversion of agency rather than only a death wish.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because أَتْرَابًا and تُرَابًا activate sharply different branches even though the packet assigns the same root. The exact within-surah root recurrence keeps the comparison anchored, but no syntax says the scenes interpret one another. Downstream prose should qualify it as a pun-like social-to-material resonance, not a claim that either word carries the other's lexical sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أَتْرَابًا at 78:33 and تُرَابًا at 78:40, both resolved through ت ر ب

activation_trace.role: Equality in age and companionship supplies a social form of parity on the successful side of the surah.
Literal dust supplies the catastrophic material leveling desired by the final speaker.

changed_reading.before: The reward scene contains peers, whereas the coverer independently wishes to be dust.
changed_reading.after: One root spans two levelings: convivial parity among peers and the coverer's catastrophic reduction to matter, making the dust-wish a bleak counterfeit of belonging among equals.

strongest_changes: The final inspection resolves the opening public dispute as private, self-involving evidence.
The middle judgment sequence turns hand-attributed deeds into a complete audit whose fitted result is experienced.
The speech restrictions recast the final quote as exposed but ineffective regret rather than negotiation.
The paired return-places make dust an impossible late non-route after accountable destination has resolved.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package made the final ayah function as a knot rather than an isolated threat: opening uncertainty closes as sight, prepared-world production closes as hand-produced evidence, cosmic becoming closes as a failed reverse-being, accounting closes as experience, and an offered return closes as a dust counterfactual. The exact ت ر ب recurrence also preserved two exploratory social/material reversals that a conservative synthesis would likely lose.
remaining_uncertainties: The degree to which يَنظُرُ carries intellectual examination, rather than only visual witnessing, remains open.
The prepared-world model depends on a reader-supplied stewardship or input-output arrow not stated directly in the packet.
حِسَابًا in 78:36 may signal measured quantity rather than sufficiency, weakening the penalty-versus-gift asymmetry.
The covering and peer/dust outliers are exact root activations but deliberately do not displace the ordinary lexical senses in the focus ayah.
